summary: Bring the live checkpoint viewer in line with the approved AFTER side of the viewer-audit prototype: no sideways scroll at 320, 44px tap targets, offline empty state, and h2 section labels, with the template and planted copy staying identical.
plain_summary: On a phone, the progress page shows all seven steps without sideways scrolling, broken plans say offline, and the empty screen and Technical details are easy to tap.
gating: Work checkpoints in order. Within a checkpoint, the gates run in order: behavior, then ui, then review. A checkpoint is "passed" only when every gate is "passed" or "n/a". Do not start checkpoint N+1 until checkpoint N has passed.

checkpoints.title: Offline badge on failed plan load
checkpoints.goal: A missing or unreadable plan file shows the empty drop and the badge text is offline, never live; load() returns false on parse failure; templates/viewer.html.tpl and .ai-engineering/workflow/checkpoints/viewer.html stay byte-identical.

plain.what: If the plan file is missing or broken, the badge says offline and the empty screen appears.
plain.why: Without this, a broken plan still looks live and hides the problem.
plain.check: Open the progress page with a missing plan name and confirm the badge says offline.

tasks: In templates/viewer.html.tpl, make load() return false when JSON.parse fails and show the empty drop.
In servedInit tick, set the badge to offline (class live off) whenever load returns false or fetch fails; never set live after a failed parse.
Copy the same bytes to .ai-engineering/workflow/checkpoints/viewer.html so the planted viewer matches the template.
Add tests/viewer-audit.spec.ts that asserts the template contains the offline-on-failure contract and that the planted viewer equals the template.
acceptance: Missing plan or parse failure shows #empty and #live textContent offline.

checkpoints.title: Empty drop and card heading levels
checkpoints.goal: Empty drop title is an h1 Open a feature plan; file input min-height 44px; long paths wrap; in-card section labels are h2 with the same visual style; page title stays h1; empty section has data-region empty-drop; planted viewer stays identical to the template.

plain.what: The empty screen has a real title, a tall file button, wrapping paths, and section labels that sit under the page title.
plain.why: Without this, the empty screen is hard to tap and headings jump a level.
plain.check: Open a missing plan on a narrow phone and confirm the title, file control, and wrapping path.

tasks: In templates/viewer.html.tpl, render the empty title as h1 Open a feature plan; set .drop input min-height 44px and .drop overflow-wrap anywhere; mark #empty with data-region="empty-drop".
Change in-card section labels from h3 to h2 (.body h2) keeping the existing label paint; keep the page title as h1.
Keep label strings matching the prototype: Feature progress, offline, Open a feature plan, and the empty-drop copy.
Mirror every edit into .ai-engineering/workflow/checkpoints/viewer.html; extend tests/viewer-audit.spec.ts for h1 empty title, h2 body labels, 44px input rule, and wrap.
acceptance: Empty drop shows one h1 Open a feature plan; file input CSS min-height is 44px; paths wrap without sideways scroll.
Card section labels are h2; no h1-to-h3 skip in the card body.
Planted viewer remains identical to the template.
